lines.name: Diacolor
lines.description: Alkaline demi-permanent. No ammonia. Up to 70% grey coverage, up to 1.5 levels of lift, 6 weeks of gloss color, 2x shine. Melanin Gap Filler Technology reinjects color inside the fiber. Up to 92% natural origin formula. 20 min processing.

developers.name: DIActivateur 6-vol
developers.use: Soft color deposit, more natural result. Shine & first grey coverage.

developers.name: DIActivateur 15-vol
developers.use: Strong color deposit, more visibility and 1.5 levels of lift.

processingTimes.use: Regrowth touch-up: take through after 10 min

applicationNotes: 1 tube (2 oz.) to 3 oz. DIActivateur developer
On natural or colored hair
Rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox Shampoo, follow with Metal Detox mask

lines.name: DiaLight
lines.description: Acidic gel-crème demi. Zero ammonia. Zero lift. Ultra conditioning. +30% more conditioning. Acid pH close to natural hair pH. Cationic polymers resurface cuticle for shine. Flexible processing: 2-20 minutes.

developers.name: DIActivateur 6-vol
developers.use: Soft color deposit, more transparent result.

applicationNotes: 1 tube (1.7 oz.) to 2.6 oz. DIActivateur developer
On colored or lightened hair only — no grey coverage, no lift
Dry hair: spray Metal Detox Pre-Treatment on each section, apply with brush or bottle
Wet hair: after shampooing with Metal Detox Shampoo, apply on pre-lightened hair
Liquifier available for fast bottle application: half dose .2 oz., full dose .4 oz.
Liquifier ONLY to be used with DiaLight + DIActivateur (not a developer)
Emulsify with warm water at end, rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox, follow with Metal Detox mask
warnings: DM5 & Rubilane shades must be used ALONE — do NOT combine with any other shade

lines.name: Inoa
lines.description: No ammonia vegan permanent color. 100% grey coverage. Powered by Oil Delivery System. Injects dyes deep into cortex for dimensional, long-lasting color. +48% shine, 87% less breakage, maintains curl pattern. No animal-derived ingredients or byproducts.

developers.name: iNOA Oil Developer 10-vol
developers.use: Up to 1 level of lift — toning, refreshing

developers.name: iNOA Oil Developer 20-vol
developers.use: Up to 2 levels of lift — grey coverage

developers.name: iNOA Oil Developer 30-vol
developers.use: Up to 3 levels of lift — more visible color change

applicationNotes: On dry hair, mist Metal Detox Pre-Treatment Spray on each section
Mix iNOA 1:1 with dedicated iNOA Oil Developer (NOT standard developer)
One tube (60g/2.1oz) + 60g/2.1oz developer
Development time starts AFTER application is complete
Rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox Shampoo or iNOA Post-Color Shampoo, then Metal Detox Mask
greyCoverage: Up to 70% white: use target shade with iNOA Oil Developer
70-100% white, warm target: ½ target shade + ½ Gold Natural (.3/G) at same level
70-100% white, cool target: ½ target shade + ½ Natural (.0/NN) at same level
70-100% white, opaque coverage: ½ target shade + ½ Extra Coverage Natural (-/N) at same level
For mid-lengths & ends: use target shade only (no mixing with Natural)
takeThrough: Dia Light take-through for colored hair:
Subtle/moderate change: last 10 min with 9-vol Diactivateur
Pronounced change: last 20 min with 9-vol Diactivateur

coolBoosters.name: Blue Booster
coolBoosters.use: Neutralize orange, intensify cool tones on levels 7-10

specialShades.carmilane: Vibrant garnet reds — cover up to 100% white alone. Do NOT mix with other shades except Clear.
specialShades.rubilane: Dimensional reds — cover up to 100% white alone. Do NOT mix with other shades except Clear.
specialShades.dm5: Deep intense shades — cover up to 100% white alone. Do NOT mix with other shades except Clear.
specialShades.extraCoverage: -/N shades — for deeper, more opaque coverage on 70-100% white hair
specialShades.goldNaturals: .3/G Gold Naturals — for warm grey coverage mixing
specialShades.clear: Dilute intensity, create pastels, color matching on mid-lengths & ends

warnings: Carmilane, Rubilane, and DM5 shades MUST be used ALONE — do NOT combine with other shades (except Clear)
iNOA Oil Developer is exclusive to iNOA — do not use standard developer
If using cool boosters on levels 7-10, level up in developer or shade to maintain target level

lines.name: Majirel
lines.description: Permanent crème haircolor. 100% perfect coverage. +45% more conditioned hair. Ionène G + Incell® Technology for surface, cuticle, and cortex conditioning. #1 choice of top colorists worldwide.

developers.name: Majicrème 40-vol (High-Lift only)
developers.use: Up to 4.5 levels of lift (High-Lift only)

applicationNotes: Mix 1.7 oz. tube + 2.6 oz. Majicrème Developer (1:1.5 ratio)
On dry hair, spray Metal Detox Pre-Treatment
Virgin application: Apply to mid-lengths/ends ½ inch from scalp, develop 15 min, then apply to regrowth and re-apply mid-lengths/ends
Regrowth application: Spray Metal Detox at regrowth, apply Majirel formula, process full development time
Rinse thoroughly, shampoo with Metal Detox Shampoo, follow with Metal Detox Mask
greyCoverage: Under 50% white: Choose target shade directly
Over 50% white, warm target: ½ target + ½ Gold shade (.3/G) at same level
Over 50% white, cool target: ½ target + ½ Natural (-/N) at same level
Majirel Cool Cover: for extreme cool coverage, use alone with 30-vol for up to 30% white
Majirel Cool Inforced: use alone or mix with Majirel Classic, same mixing guidelines

subLines.coolCover: 23 shades — deeper, more opaque cool coverage for resistant grey. Long-lasting coolness.
subLines.coolInforced: 11 shades — cool result with boosted cool reflects. Up to 6 weeks neutralization. Use alone or mix with Classic.
subLines.majirouge: Dimensional coppers and reds — intense, vibrant, long-lasting
subLines.highLift: Ultra-light blonding and toning in one step. 1:2 mix ratio with 30 or 40 vol. Not for white coverage.

specialShades.carmilane: Vibrant garnet reds — MUST be used alone, do NOT mix with other shades from different technology family
specialShades.rubilane: Dimensional reds — MUST be used alone, do NOT mix with other shades from different technology family
specialShades.lumax: Intense vibrant reds — MUST be used alone
specialShades.dm5: Deep intense shades — MUST be used alone
specialShades.extraCoverage: .0/NN Extra Coverage Natural shades — for deeper, more opaque coverage on 70-100% white hair
specialShades.clear: Break the base, subdue tone intensity, create lighter shades, create pastels

warnings: Carmilane, Lumax, Rubilane, and DM5 shades MUST be used ALONE — do NOT combine with shades from different technology families
Cross-technology mixing FORBIDDEN (e.g., Carmilane 5.60 + Lumax 6.60 = NO)
Perform skin allergy test 48 hours before use

specialNotes: Diacolor: alkaline demi-permanent with Melanin Gap Filler Technology
DiaLight: acidic demi-permanent, zero lift, for color-treated/sensitized hair
DM5 and Rubilane shades must be used ALONE — do NOT combine with any other shade
Metal Detox protocol: Pre-Treatment spray → color service → Metal Detox Shampoo → Metal Detox Mask
DiaLight Liquifier is NOT a developer — only for consistency adjustment
Diacolor has Clear shade for softening intensity or creating custom lighter shades
